summary: Tara Gray, 31, of Durango, lost handhold descending the east side of Elkhead Pass and fell ~50 ft down a steep rocky embankment, suffering a severe head injury and fractured ankle; overdue at the Missouri Gulch trailhead, she was found in Missouri Basin by two Boulder hikers who camped with her until a Flight for Life helicopter airlifted her to Penrose Hospital in Colorado Springs
location: Elkhead Pass / Missouri Basin, Missouri Mountain, Collegiate Peaks Wilderness
responding_agency: Chaffee County Search and Rescue; Chaffee County Sheriff's Office
notes: Fell ~noon Sat 2023-05-27; reported missing ~8pm; found ~10:30pm by Phil Dougan and Larry Kutt; helo airlift ~1am Sun 2023-05-28; listed stable at Penrose Sunday. Long-standing dateless Mountain Mail pending lead, resolved 2026-09-14: article crawl-age (1204d) + Sat/Sun narrative pins the incident to 2023-05-27 (Saturday-verified).
